entities.name: Arabidopsis OHP1
observations: Exact sequence match to UniProt O81208; 110 aa, approximately 12.0 kDa, predicted pI 9.57.
A small chloroplast thylakoid single-pass membrane protein associated with both photosystems I and II.
Forms complexes with OHP2 and HCF244 involved in PSII core-subunit assembly and repair.
With OHP2, forms a pigment-binding heterodimer that may deliver chlorophylls and carotenoids to the PsbA/D1 subunit.

entities.name: Photosystem II assembly
observations: OHP1-containing complexes promote early PSII core-subunit assembly and PSII repair in chloroplast thylakoids.
The OHP1/OHP2/HCF244 complex is implicated in recruitment of ribosomes to psbA mRNA during PSII biogenesis and repair.

entities.name: Chloroplast thylakoid membrane
observations: OHP1 is localized to the chloroplast thylakoid membrane and associated with photosystems I and II.
